title: Vector P4: eraser on the planar mesh, curve-preserving + eraser modes
description: Depends on Vector P3. Re-target the eraser from per-object Greiner-Hormann (engine/eraser.ts, which flattens curves) to subtract from the LAYER planar arrangement: remove fill area from faces and TRIM/SPLIT half-edges (strokes), PRESERVING quadratics (no polyline flattening). Reuse the existing GH machinery but make it curve-aware via the P0 kernel. Implement Flash 8 eraser modes (Normal, Erase Fills, Erase Lines, Erase Selected, Erase Inside) + faucet (click removes a whole fill/line). VERIFY: build + tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); Ruffle oracle: 'erase a stroke through a disk -> disk splits into two, curve silhouette preserved'; 'erase across a fill cuts it'; modes behave correctly; existing eraser tests still pass (adapt as needed). Update docs/36-vector-merge-model.md. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Conflict hotspots: engine/eraser.ts, StageArea.tsx eraser wiring. Sequential after P3.
